name: Roofing squares estimator
summary: Roofing squares from plan area, a pitch multiplier, and waste.
author: friday-core
description: squares = planArea × pitchFactor × (1+waste) / 100 (if area in ft²). Pass pitchFactor as a number (e.g. 1.12). This is a planning aid, not a substitute for a licensed engineer's calculations or sign-off, and it is not professional certification. Not a structural roof design.
